_comment: PhantomNet Sprint Config — Week 23 (Month 6 Week 3: Documentation + Demo Preparation, Days 51-55)
milestone_description: Advanced features, CVE mapping, audit logging, system hardening, comprehensive E2E testing, and final V3.0 production delivery.

tasks.Title: V3 Architecture README Rewrite
tasks.Objective: Rewrite README.md to provide a complete, comprehensive, and professional overview of PhantomNet V3 architecture, features, quickstart instructions, and sentinel capabilities.
Tasks: Rewrite README.md with full V3 system overview and capabilities breakdown.
Document end-to-end pipeline (honeypot capture -> ML detection -> MITRE ATT&CK mapping -> Snort/Sigma rule generation -> Playbook generation -> TAXII feed / SOC export).
Include setup/installation steps, quick start guide, environment variables, and Docker deployment commands.
Add status badges, feature matrices, and architecture component summaries.
Warnings: **Do NOT** delete or break existing quickstart references and Docker guidelines.

tasks.Title: Sentinel Layer Technical Documentation
tasks.Objective: Author comprehensive technical documentation for the Sentinel module covering architecture, threat aggregation, playbook lifecycle, and active defense.
Tasks: Create docs/sentinel_layer.md detailing Sentinel architecture, data flow, and database models (SentinelPlaybook, SentinelAuditLog).
Document signature extraction from honeypot payloads, MITRE technique mapping rules, and playbook generation triggers.
Detail SOC analyst workflows (approval, rejection, batch operations, rule export, and retention policies).

tasks.Title: LLM Integration and AI Playbook Guide
tasks.Objective: Author dedicated documentation for the Ollama/Mistral LLM integration, prompt templates, few-shot prompt engineering, and offline graceful fallbacks.
Tasks: Create docs/llm_integration.md detailing Ollama setup, hardware requirements (GPU/CPU), and model selection (Mistral 7B / fallback Gemma 2B).
Document LLM prompt architecture, structured context injection, and few-shot formatting.
Document response time tracking, timeout resilience, background task execution, and template-only fallback behavior.

tasks.Title: Full Pipeline Architecture Diagram and Visual Assets
tasks.Objective: Create high-resolution Mermaid and visual architecture diagrams illustrating the full end-to-end pipeline and UI component structure.
Tasks: Author Mermaid diagram in docs/diagrams/pipeline_architecture.md showing packet ingestion -> ML inference -> Sentinel -> UI / TAXII.
Generate frontend component hierarchy diagram for Sentinel dashboard, playbook viewer, Mitre matrix, and timeline analytics.
Export diagrams to web-ready formats and organize in docs/images/ and docs/diagrams/.
Deliverables: Mermaid diagrams and visual assets in docs/images/.

tasks.Title: Sentinel API Reference Documentation and OpenAPI Spec
tasks.Objective: Write exhaustive API reference documentation and update OpenAPI specification for all Sentinel REST endpoints with request/response schemas.
Tasks: Author docs/api_documentation_v2.md documenting all Sentinel endpoints (playbooks, batch actions, compare, rules export, timeline, audit logs, TAXII 2.1).
Provide curl, Python requests, and JSON payload examples for each endpoint.
Update docs/openapi.json / OpenAPI schema with new request bodies, query params, and HTTP status codes.

tasks.Title: IDS Rule Generation and Detection Formats Documentation
tasks.Objective: Author comprehensive documentation on automated Snort and Sigma rule generation, syntax validation, deduplication, and export mechanisms.
Tasks: Create docs/ids_rules.md explaining Snort 2.9/3.0 rule structures, header options, classtypes, SIDs, and thresholds.
Document Sigma rule generation, YAML schema compliance, condition syntax, and logsource mappings.
Detail rule deduplication algorithms and the combined ZIP export feature (/api/v1/sentinel/rules/export-all).

tasks.Title: Playbook Template Authoring and Customization Guide
tasks.Objective: Author documentation for Jinja2 playbook templates, template inheritance, variable dictionaries, and authoring guidelines for new attack scenarios.
Tasks: Create docs/playbook_templates.md explaining Jinja2 template structure (base_playbook.md.j2, attack-specific templates).
Document all template context variables (cluster metadata, IOC tables, MITRE tactics, containment steps, recovery procedures).
Provide step-by-step developer tutorial for adding new incident response playbook templates.

tasks.Title: Live Demonstration Script and Storyboard
tasks.Objective: Author a comprehensive, step-by-step live demo script and user journey storyboard showcasing the entire PhantomNet V3 platform.
Tasks: Create docs/demo_script.md containing a minute-by-minute demonstration walkthrough.
Detail step-by-step narrative: attack simulation -> real-time traffic detection -> ML scoring -> Sentinel incident response -> playbook approval -> TAXII feed / rule export.
Include UI highlight callouts (dark theme, ATT&CK heatmap, timeline spikes, side-by-side diff comparison).

tasks.Title: Demo Video 1 Production: End-to-End Pipeline
tasks.Objective: Record and produce Demo Video #1 showcasing the complete automated pipeline: attack injection -> playbook generation -> approval -> SOC export.
Tasks: Execute live attack simulation against honeypots (SSH brute-force, SQL injection).
Capture backend aggregation, ML inference, and Sentinel playbook generation.
Demonstrate SOC analyst review, one-click playbook approval, and PDF/STIX/Markdown export.
Produce and save demo recording / capture in demos/demo_pipeline_e2e.mp4.
Deliverables: Demo Video #1 artifact in demos/ or documentation summary.

tasks.Title: Demo Video 2 Production: IDS Rules and TAXII Feed
tasks.Objective: Record and produce Demo Video #2 demonstrating automated Snort/Sigma rule generation, rule deduplication, and external TAXII 2.1 STIX feed consumption.
Tasks: Demonstrate real-time Snort and Sigma rule generation from detected attack payloads.
Demonstrate combined ZIP download of IDS rules.
Execute taxii2-client verification demonstrating external TAXII discovery, collection query, and STIX 2.1 bundle consumption.
Produce and save demo recording / capture in demos/demo_ids_taxii.mp4.
Deliverables: Demo Video #2 artifact in demos/ or documentation summary.

tasks.Title: Demo Video 3 Production: LLM Enhancement and ATT&CK Matrix
tasks.Objective: Record and produce Demo Video #3 highlighting LLM narrative generation, prompt contextualization, and interactive MITRE ATT&CK coverage heatmap.
Tasks: Demonstrate AI Narrative generation with Ollama/Mistral integration vs template fallback.
Showcase ATT&CK Matrix visualization tab, technique coverage heatmaps, and filtering.
Demonstrate quality scoring and campaign timeline progression charts.
Produce and save demo recording / capture in demos/demo_ai_mitre.mp4.
Deliverables: Demo Video #3 artifact in demos/ or documentation summary.

tasks.Title: Demo Video 4 Production: Dashboard UI Walkthrough
tasks.Objective: Record and produce Demo Video #4 providing a polished, comprehensive walkthrough of all dashboard pages, themes, and interactive features.
Tasks: Walk through Overview Dashboard, Honeypot Monitors, ML Model Analytics, Sentinel Dashboard, Playbook Viewer, and Admin Settings.
Highlight theme switching (dark/light), multi-select batch approval, and search filters.
Record and produce demo recording / capture in demos/demo_dashboard_walkthrough.mp4.
Deliverables: Demo Video #4 artifact in demos/ or documentation summary.

tasks.Title: Project Report Section 1: Architecture and Design Decisions
tasks.Objective: Author Section 1 of the formal Final Project Report focusing on system architecture, component modularity, scalability, and design trade-offs.
Tasks: Write architecture report section covering layered micro-architecture (Collector, Classifier, Sentinel, Presentation).
Document architectural design decisions, technology stack selections, and database concurrency handling.
Detail API design philosophy, state management, and enterprise integration patterns.

tasks.Title: Project Report Section 2: Threat Detection and Security Hardening
tasks.Objective: Author Section 2 of the formal Final Project Report detailing threat detection efficacy, honeypot emulation, IDS rules, and security audits.
Tasks: Write security report section detailing honeypot protocols (SSH, HTTP, FTP, SMTP), capture mechanisms, and attack scenario coverage.
Document MITRE ATT&CK mapping accuracy, Snort/Sigma rule generation fidelity, and TAXII 2.1 threat sharing.
Summarize vulnerability management, red-team penetration tests, and API security hardening.

tasks.Title: Project Report Section 3: Machine Learning and LLM Integration
tasks.Objective: Author Section 3 of the formal Final Project Report covering ML detection models, feature extraction, evaluation metrics, and LLM narrative synthesis.
Tasks: Write ML report section detailing anomaly detection models, supervised classifiers, feature engineering pipelines, and F1-score benchmarks.
Document Ollama/Mistral integration, prompt optimization, few-shot examples, and latency benchmarks.
Document threat scoring, quality metrics, and campaign timeline density modeling.

tasks.Title: Project Report Section 4: Frontend Design and User Experience
tasks.Objective: Author Section 4 of the formal Final Project Report covering UI/UX architecture, dashboard ergonomics, design systems, and usability testing.
Tasks: Write frontend report section detailing React architecture, component library, state management, and real-time polling.
Document UI/UX design choices, dark/light theme implementation, accessibility standards, and responsive breakpoints.
Summarize usability testing, SOC analyst workflow efficiencies, and frontend performance metrics.

tasks.Title: Comprehensive Documentation Review and Audit
tasks.Objective: Lead formal review of all project documentation, report sections, and guides for technical accuracy, completeness, and alignment with master plan.
Tasks: Review and audit all newly created documentation files in docs/ and README.md.
Ensure cross-references, API schemas, and installation commands are verified and accurate.
Consolidate individual report sections into a unified Master Final Project Report.

tasks.Title: Security and Compliance Documentation Review
tasks.Objective: Review and sign off on all security documentation, TAXII specifications, IDS rule catalogs, and pentest summaries.
Tasks: Verify accuracy of docs/ids_rules.md, docs/taxii_interoperability.md, and docs/sentinel_layer.md.
Ensure all CVE references, attack signatures, and MITRE IDs in documentation match backend implementations.
Complete Security Documentation Sign-off for Week 23.

tasks.Title: AI/ML Documentation Verification and Presentation Compilation
tasks.Objective: Review AI/ML and LLM documentation, compile recorded demo videos into presentation slides, and prepare media assets.
Tasks: Verify accuracy of docs/llm_integration.md and docs/playbook_templates.md.
Assemble demo video clips and diagrams into project presentation deck / slide outline.
Complete AI/ML documentation sign-off for Week 23.

tasks.Objective: Update the GitHub repository presentation, embed demo GIFs/screenshots into README and documentation, and ensure clean repository appearance.
Tasks: Generate animated demo GIFs from UI walkthrough videos.
Embed screenshots and GIFs into README.md and docs/ guides.
